At p48-q9-root: Append (d): Find b>0 such that ∫₀ᵇ x/√(1+x²) dx=1. Answer: √(1+b²)-1=1, so b=√3.

[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-052f689d51]
At p54-q8: Append: (c) Evaluate ∫₀^{π/2}sin⁴x dx. Answer: 3π/16. (d) Evaluate ∫₀^{π/2}cos⁴x dx. Answer: 3π/16. (e) Using your identities, explain why the integrals are equal. Answer: their only differing term is ±½cos 2x, whose integral over this interval is zero.
